name: Chalicmere Castle
title: Chalicmere Castle
summary: Chalicmere is the open fortress in the heart of the Direlands described at length in Aerfalle's Letter, where Faladha the Emissary opens a portal to Aerlinthe. In the kit it is a narrow north-south castle on a valley floor (z 34) under a western ridge. A six-story red-roofed keep with a spire (0x01000DFF, 31.5 m) stands among a tapered south tower, a green-glass spire tower and two north spire towers. Pitched-roof halls and walls frame a courtyard of large flowering trees, with a well. Giant wooden mask statues stand outside the west wall, and golem camps surround the castle.

shots.standingOrder: Corkscrew clockwise up the west side of Chalicmere from 10 m to 40 m, 62 to 80 m out, the low sun behind the lens on the red keep, towers and courtyard trees.
shots.notes: Signature view: the drone corkscrews clockwise up the west side of Chalicmere from bearing 228 to 264, climbing from 10 m to 40 m and widening from 62 m to 80 m. The red-roofed 31 m keep, the tapered south tower, the green-glass spire towers, the walls and the flowering courtyard trees turn in the warm low sun behind the lens. The valley and the eastern hills open beyond.
